chapel.englishDescription: In Christianity, a building to worship or go to mass in.

director.englishDescription: The position of managing business of a company or organization and representing it legally; a person in such a position.

director.definitionKo: 행정 기관이나 사무 부서의 하나인 처의 책임자.
director.englishDescription: A person who is responsible for a division in an administrative agency or office department.

director.definitionKo: 구청, 경찰청 등과 같이 ‘-청’자가 붙은 기관에서 가장 지위가 높은 사람.
director.englishDescription: A person in the highest position of an institution such as a ward office, police agency, etc.

disclosing.englishDescription: The act of telling another person a fact that should be hidden.

discourteous.definitionKo: 윗사람 앞에서 조심하거나 어려워하지 않고 매우 무례하다.
discourteous.englishDescription: Very rude to one's superior, lacking in discipline or respect.

disownment.definitionKo: 구성원 명단에서 이름을 뺌으로써 구성원의 자격을 빼앗음. 또는 그런 행위.
disownment.englishDescription: The act of depriving someone of membership by removing his/her name from the list of members, or such action.

disproof.definitionKo: 반대되는 근거를 들어 어떤 사실이나 주장이 옳지 않음을 증명함. 또는 그런 증거.
disproof.englishDescription: The act of refuting that a fact or argument is wrong through counterevidence, or such an evidence.

disproof.definitionKo: 어떤 사실과 모순되는 것 같지만, 오히려 그것을 증명한다고 볼 수 있는 사실.
disproof.englishDescription: A fact that seems to contradict a certain fact, but instead proves that it is right.

dissimulation.definitionKo: 자기가 하고도 하지 않은 척하거나 알고도 모르는 척하는 태도.
dissimulation.englishDescription: The attitude of pretenting not to have done something while one actually did or pretending not to know something while one actually does.

dissimulation.definitionKo: 자기가 하고도 하지 않은 척하거나 알고도 모르는 척하는 태도.
dissimulation.englishDescription: The attitude of pretenting not to have done something while one actually did or pretending not to know something while one actually does.

divergence.englishDescription: An act of starting to do something else, instead of seeking one’s own goal.

divide.englishDescription: To divide something into separate parts.

divide.definitionKo: 잘라서 열거나 여러 개가 되게 하다.
divide.englishDescription: To cut something open or make it into several pieces.
To divide something into separate parts.

divide.definitionKo: 어떤 기준에 따라 전체를 몇 개의 부분으로 나누다.
divide.englishDescription: To categorize a whole into several parts according to a standard.

divide.definitionKo: 원래 하나였던 것을 둘 이상의 부분이나 조각이 되게 하다.
divide.englishDescription: To divide something that was one into two or more parts or pieces.
To divide land or space with boundaries.
To divide an amount of something equally.

divide.definitionKo: 본래 하나였던 것을 둘 이상으로 나누다.
divide.englishDescription: To divide something that was a whole into more than two groups.
To divide work, responsibility, etc., to allot such things to each person.
To divide something into several parts.

divide.definitionKo: 원래 하나이던 것에서 서로 다른 여러 갈래나 종류로 나누어지다.
divide.englishDescription: For something to be divided into several different parts or kinds.

divide.definitionKo: 갈라져서 따로 자리하다. 또는 나누어서 자리하게 하다.
divide.englishDescription: For things to be divided and separately established, or to divide and establish things separately.

divide.definitionKo: 물이 두 방향으로 갈라져서 흐르는 경계가 되는 산맥.
divide.englishDescription: A mountain range that is a dividing point for water flowing in two directions.

divide.definitionKo: 하나의 집단, 단체, 사상 등을 여러 개로 갈라 나뉘게 하다.
divide.englishDescription: To divide one group, organization, idea, etc., into many parts.

divide.definitionKo: 하나의 세포 또는 개체를 여러 개로 나누어 불어나게 하다.
divide.englishDescription: To divide one cell or entity into many.

doodling.definitionKo: 글이나 그림을 장난으로 아무 데나 함부로 쓰거나 그림. 또는 그러한 글이나 그림.
doodling.englishDescription: The act of writing or drawing anywhere for fun, or the writing or drawing made in this manner.

downsizing.definitionKo: 사람 수를 줄임. 또는 그 사람 수.
downsizing.englishDescription: Reduction in the number of people or the reduced number.

downsizing.definitionKo: 사물의 크기가 작아짐. 또는 그렇게 함.
downsizing.englishDescription: The size of an object becoming smaller, or making something that way.

dustiness.definitionKo: 여기저기에 먼지가 잔뜩 묻어서 더러운 상태.
dustiness.englishDescription: A dirty state in which there is dust everywhere.

elapse.englishDescription: To get out of a period as time passes.

electricity.definitionKo: 빛이나 열을 내거나 기계 등을 움직이는 데 쓰이는 에너지.
electricity.englishDescription: An energy used to produce light or heat or to operate a machine.

electricity.definitionKo: 전류가 일정한 시간 동안 하는 일. 또는 일정한 시간 동안 사용되는 에너지의 양.
electricity.englishDescription: The amount of energy used during a certain period of time.

emblem.definitionKo: 추상적인 사물이나 개념을 구체적인 사물로 나타냄. 또는 그렇게 나타낸 구체적인 사물.
emblem.englishDescription: The act of expressing an abstract matter or concept as a concrete thing, or a concrete thing expressed such a way.
An object that expresses an abstract concept in a concrete way.

emblem.definitionKo: 추상적이거나 드러나지 않은 것을 구체적인 모양으로 나타냄.
emblem.englishDescription: Expressing something abstract or unrevealed in a concrete form.

endlessly.definitionKo: 끝이 없을 만큼 정도가 매우 크게.
endlessly.englishDescription: So much as to be considered limitless.

endlessly.definitionKo: 수나 양, 크기, 공간이나 시간의 끝이나 제한이 없이.
endlessly.englishDescription: With no end or limit of number, amount, size, space or time.

endlessly.definitionKo: 어떤 행동이나 감정 등이 그치지 않고 계속되는 상태로.
endlessly.englishDescription: In a state in which a certain act or emotion continues without stopping.
In a state of having no end or limit.

epicure.definitionKo: 맛있고 좋은 음식을 찾아 먹는 것을 즐기는 사람.
epicure.englishDescription: A person who enjoys seeking out and eating tasty, high-quality food.

epoch-making.definitionKo: 어떤 과정이나 분야에서 전혀 새로운 시기를 열어 놓을 만큼 이전의 것과 뚜렷이 구분되는.
epoch-making.englishDescription: Being clearly distinguished from before, opening a whole new era in a certain process or sector.

eruel.definitionKo: 앞말이 어떤 행위의 목적지나 도달점임을 나타내는 조사.
eruel.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate that the preceding statement is the destination or purpose of an act.

eseo.definitionKo: 앞말이 행동이 이루어지고 있는 장소임을 나타내는 조사.
eseo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate that the preceding word refers to a place where a certain action is being done.
A postpositional particle used to indicate that the preceding word refers to the starting point of something.

eseo.definitionKo: 앞말이 어떤 일의 출처임을 나타내는 조사.
eseo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate that the preceding word refers to the source of something.
A postpositional particle used to indicate that the preceding word refers to a ground for doing something.

eseo.definitionKo: 앞말이 비교의 기준이 되는 점의 뜻을 나타내는 조사.
eseo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate that the preceding word refers to a criterion for comparison.
A postpositional particle used to indicate that the preceding word refers to the subject of the sentence.

evacuate.englishDescription: To make a situation in which no one remains in a certain place.
To discharge urine or excrement from the body.

evacuate.definitionKo: 위험을 피해 잠깐 안전한 곳으로 가다.
evacuate.englishDescription: To go to a safe place for a short stay away from danger.

evacuate.definitionKo: 생물체가 영양소를 섭취한 후 생긴 노폐물을 몸 밖으로 내보내다.
evacuate.englishDescription: For an organism to discharge waste matter that formed after taking in nutrients.

evacuate.definitionKo: 있던 곳에서 시설이나 장비 등을 거두어 가지고 물러나다.
evacuate.englishDescription: To gather up the equipment, supplies, etc., and leave a place where one has been stationed.

evacuate.definitionKo: 있던 곳에서 시설이나 장비 등을 거두어 가지고 물러나게 하다.
evacuate.englishDescription: To make people gather up their equipment, supplies, etc., and leave a place where they have been stationed.

evacuate.definitionKo: 전투가 벌어지고 있는 곳에서 부상자, 물자, 포로 등을 뒤에 있는 지역으로 보내다.
evacuate.englishDescription: To transport the wounded, supplies, prisoners, etc., away from the battlefront back to the area at the rear.

evacuation.definitionKo: 생물체가 영양소를 섭취한 후 생긴 노폐물을 몸 밖으로 내보내는 일.
evacuation.englishDescription: The act or process of an organism discharging waste matter that formed after taking in nutrients.

evacuation.definitionKo: 있던 곳에서 시설이나 장비 등을 거두어 가지고 물러남.
evacuation.englishDescription: An act of gathering up the equipment, supplies, etc., and leaving a place where one has been stationed.

evacuation.definitionKo: 전쟁, 자연재해 등의 재난을 피해 멀리 도망감.
evacuation.englishDescription: An act of running away from a catastrophe such as a war, natural disaster, etc.

evacuation.definitionKo: 전쟁이나 난리 등을 피해 멀리 도망감.
evacuation.englishDescription: An act of running away from a catastrophe such as a war, disturbance, etc.

evacuation.definitionKo: 전투가 벌어지고 있는 곳에서 부상자, 물자, 포로 등을 뒤에 있는 지역으로 보냄.
evacuation.englishDescription: An act of transporting the wounded, supplies, prisoners, etc., away from the battlefront back to the area at the rear.

evil.definitionKo: 날씨나 사람의 성격이나 언행, 또는 맛과 냄새 등이 나쁜 데가 있다.
evil.englishDescription: The weather, behavior, or a personality, remark, smell, taste, etc., being bad.
Personality, words or actions being bad-natured.
One's mind or behavior being bad and mean.

evil.definitionKo: 올바르지 않고 도덕적 기준에 어긋나 나쁜 것.
evil.englishDescription: Something not right, bad, and against a moral standard.
One's personality being presumptuous and rough.

excerpt.definitionKo: 책이나 글에서 필요하거나 중요한 부분을 가려 뽑아 냄. 또는 뽑아 낸 글.
excerpt.englishDescription: An act of singling out necessary or important parts from a book or text; or a piece of writing extracted from the source.

excerpt.definitionKo: 글이나 책에서 필요한 부분만을 뽑아서 적음. 또는 그런 기록.
excerpt.englishDescription: An act of choosing and writing only necessary parts from a piece of writing or a book, or such a record.

expatriate.definitionKo: 다른 나라에서 살고 있는 같은 나라 또는 같은 민족의 사람.
expatriate.englishDescription: A person of the same country or race, who is living in another country.

expropriate.definitionKo: 본래 개인의 소유였던 것을 국가나 공공 기관이 거두어들여 사용하다.
expropriate.englishDescription: For the government or a public institution to take and use something that was originally the property of an individual.

fart.englishDescription: To let out a fart out of one's body.

fart.definitionKo: 몸속에서 항문을 통해 몸 밖으로 나오는 고약한 냄새가 나는 기체.
fart.englishDescription: A foul-smelling gas in the body that is expelled through the anus.

fir.definitionKo: 잎은 짧은 바늘 모양으로 사계절 내내 푸르며, 수십 미터까지 높이 곧게 자라는 나무.
fir.englishDescription: An evergreen tree with leaves resembling short needles that grows straight up to tens of meters high.

firepower.definitionKo: 총, 포, 폭탄 등의 무기의 힘과 성능.
firepower.englishDescription: The power and capacity of weapons such as guns, cannons, bombs, etc.

follow-up.definitionKo: 이미 나온 책이나 드라마, 영화 등의 내용에 이어져 나오는 것.
follow-up.englishDescription: A narrative that continues the story following that in a book, soap opera, movie, etc., that already exists.

follow-up.definitionKo: 이미 만들어진 책이나 영화의 뒤에 이어지는 이야기를 다룬 것.
follow-up.englishDescription: A narrative that continues the story following that in a book or movie that already exists.
An act of following up something with something else.

follow-up.definitionKo: 이미 만들어진 책이나 영화 등의 뒤에 이어지는 이야기로 만들어진 것.
follow-up.englishDescription: A narrative or episode that continues the story following that in a book or movie that already exists.

fossil.definitionKo: 아주 옛날에 살았던 생물의 뼈, 활동 흔적 등이 땅속에 묻혀 굳어져 지금까지 남아 있는 것.
fossil.englishDescription: A state in which the bones, traces of living, etc., left by organisms from very old times have been buried under the ground and preserved to the present.

fossil.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 변화하거나 발전하지 않고 어떤 상태에서 돌처럼 굳어 버린 것.
fossil.englishDescription: (figurative) A state of remaining firm in a certain state like a stone without showing any change or progress.

frequent.englishDescription: A certain phenomenon or incident frequently taking place repeatedly.

frequent.definitionKo: 드나들거나 연락하는 일 등이 매우 자주 있다.
frequent.englishDescription: Frequent in coming and going, or making contact.

frequent.definitionKo: 들어가고 나오고 하거나 왔다 갔다 하는 일 등이 자주 있다.
frequent.englishDescription: Often coming and going, or entering and coming out.

frugal.definitionKo: 일이나 살림을 착실하고 실속 있게 하여 빈틈이 없다.
frugal.englishDescription: Doing a job or house chores dutifully and thoroughly, without wasting resources.

frugal.definitionKo: 일이나 살림을 규모 있고 계획성 있게 하여 빈틈이 없다.
frugal.englishDescription: Keeping the finance of one's household or business well planned and managed.

frugal.definitionKo: 사람됨이나 씀씀이 등이 매우 실속 있고 헤프지 않다.
frugal.englishDescription: Planned in one's spending, not wasteful.

frugal.definitionKo: 돈이나 물건 등을 아껴 쓰는 데가 있다.
frugal.englishDescription: Spending or using money or things sparingly.

gaekju.definitionKo: (옛날에) 다른 지역에서 온 상인을 상대로 여관 영업을 하며 물건을 맡아 팔거나 물건 살 사람을 소개해 주기도 하던 사람. 또는 그런 집.
gaekju.englishExpression: gaekju; keeper of an inn for traveling salesmen; peddler's inn
gaekju.englishDescription: (archaic) A person who used to sell goods to merchants traveling from other regions or introduce merchants who would buy such goods; the inn where such transactions took place.

galaxy.definitionKo: 흰 구름 모양으로 길게 보이는 수많은 천체의 무리.
galaxy.englishDescription: A long cluster of numerous heavenly bodies in the shape of a white cloud.

galaxy.definitionKo: 은하를 이루고 있는 수많은 천체의 집단.
galaxy.englishDescription: A long cluster of numerous heavenly bodies that form a galaxy.

gangnam.definitionKo: 한강을 기준으로 한 서울의 남쪽 지역.
gangnam.englishDescription: The southern part of Seoul, south of the Hangang River.

gluttony.definitionKo: 음식을 탐냄. 또는 탐내어 많이 먹음.
gluttony.englishDescription: The state of coveting food, or an act of eating a lot of food as one is gluttonous.
An act of eating much food until one feels full.

goblet.englishDescription: A vessel from which alcohol is drunk.

goreoteut.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '고러하듯' (a conjugated form of '고러하다' (be so)).

gwiyangsari.definitionKo: (옛날에) 귀양의 형벌을 받고 정해진 지역에 가서 제한된 생활을 하는 일.
gwiyangsari.englishDescription: (archaic) The act of living in a designated area under limited conditions after a punishment of exile has been imposed.

gyedon.englishDescription: Money that the members of a savings club gather for or receive from the club.

hal.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit of proportion.

halo.definitionKo: 달 주위에 둥그렇게 생기는 구름같이 뿌연 테.
halo.englishDescription: A cloud-like murky ring that is formed around the moon.

halo.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 사물을 더욱 빛나게 하거나 돋보이게 하는 배경.
halo.englishDescription: (figurative) A background that makes a certain object look nicer or stand out.

halt.englishDescription: To suspend or stop something in the middle.

halt.definitionKo: 움직이고 있던 것이 멈춤. 또는 멈추게 함.
halt.englishDescription: The act of a moving object stopping, or making it stop.

halt.definitionKo: 말이나 글이 이치에 닿지 않아 막히는 모양.
halt.englishDescription: The manner in which one's words or writing does not make sense without failing to continue.

handler.definitionKo: 인형이나 꼭두각시 등을 뒤에서 다루어 움직이게 하는 사람.
handler.englishDescription: A person who handles a doll, puppet, etc., behind the scenes to make it move.

hang.definitionKo: 줄이나 실, 끈 등으로 어떤 곳에 달려 있게 하다.

hang.definitionKo: 목을 옭아매어 죽이다.

hang.definitionKo: 기체나 기운이 주위에 가득 차다.
hang.englishDescription: For an atmosphere or a spirit to fill the air.

hang.definitionKo: 어떤 것의 주위를 감듯이 빙빙 돌다.
hang.englishDescription: To circle around a certain thing as if winding it.

hang.definitionKo: 볕을 쬐거나 바람을 쐬거나 하여 말리기 위해, 빨래나 곡식 같은 것이 넓게 펼쳐 놓이다.
hang.englishDescription: To spread out grains or hang out clothes to be dried in the sun or wind.

hang.definitionKo: 천이나 줄 등이 아래로 늘어지다. 또는 그렇게 되게 하다.
